messages:
jordan_cs: Hey team, SapphireAI account suspended for overdue payment. Customer says they uploaded a PO yesterday but service cut at 09:12 UTC. Invoice 2024-INV-789, charge id ch_3KQx7T. Can finance check?
collections-bot: invoice 2024-INV-789 marked overdue (aged 15 days). Automatic suspension executed at 2024-10-01T09:12:34Z.
alex_support: I pulled the support ticket — they uploaded a message but I don't see a PDF attachment in our portal. Ticket #5234 has note "PO coming" and PO# PO-3321 in the body.
li_payments: Looking in payments gateway — I see 3 failed attempts: last failure = 3DS auth timeout, rc=timeout_3ds, attempts at 2024-09-29T22:03, 22:15, 22:40 UTC. No successful capture.
maria_billing: Confirmed: no PO attached to the invoice in billing. System didn't create a manual invoice because finance hasn't accepted a PO. Also flagged VAT mismatch: billing addr = US, VAT number provided looks EU (GB123456789). Need VAT validation.
jordan_cs: Customer is pushing back — says procurement sent PO to billing@redwood.com and to support. They want immediate reinstatement while docs are verified.
maria_billing: We can do provisional reinstatement but require: (1) PO PDF uploaded to billing@ with PO# in subject, (2) if they claim EU VAT, a signed VAT self-cert or correct billing address. Without that we must charge VAT on the manual invoice.
alex_support: Legal ok with provisional access for short window. What's the policy window?
maria_billing: Policy = 24h provisional access after we receive the PO and VAT doc. Finance will create a manual invoice: INV-789-MAN and mark as "awaiting payment". If payment isn't received in 24h we re-suspend. Note: we need AP approval for invoices > $50k.
li_payments: For transparency: if they prefer card retry, they must re-auth 3DS from billing portal. Our gateway error log: ```gateway: checkout-gw01; error: 3ds_timeout; txn: ch_3KQx7T; redirect_url timed out after 30s``` so card path likely flaky.
jordan_cs: I'll ask CS to request PO PDF + VAT cert and to tell them about the 3DS issue. Can someone please provisionally unsuspend once they upload?
maria_billing: I can do the manual steps. Procedure: 1) confirm PO PDF received (email/pdf) 2) validate VAT at VIES (if EU) 3) create manual invoice INV-789-MAN and attach PO 4) run provisional reinstatement flag in admin console. Command we use:
```
# admin support run
/reinstate account SapphireAI --temporary 24h --reason "Awaiting PO - PO# PO-3321"
```
Add note in ticket that VAT validation pending.
alex_support: I'll message the customer now: offer 24h provisional access on receipt of PO+VAT doc, explain they can also attempt card retry.
li_payments: Once they upload PO, ping me and I'll check payment path if they want to retry. If they insist on invoice via PO and their AP is slow, we can accept PO as contractual promise but require remittance terms on the manual invoice.
jordan_cs: Customer replied: "PO uploaded to billing@, sent at 09:05 UTC, file name PO-3321_SapphireAI.pdf" — forwarding to maria.
maria_billing: Received the PDF, PO# matches. VAT number present but billing address still shows US. Asked them to confirm billing address or sign VAT self-cert.
collections-bot: note added: provisional_reinstate requested by maria_billing for 24h.
maria_billing: Done — created manual invoice INV-789-MAN (link: https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-789-MAN). Set account active flag for 24h. Please update ticket and monitor. :white_check_mark:
alex_support: Noted, I'll update the customer and close the escalation for now. If VAT validation fails we'll require immediate payment including VAT.
jordan_cs: Thanks everyone — please mark follow-up for finance if invoice not paid within 24h.
li_payments: Will monitor and post txn updates. If they want card retry, advise to use the billing portal and watch for the 3DS modal (may need different browser).
maria_billing: Closing loop: PO accepted provisionally, VAT pending — will either finalize manual invoice charging or revert after 24h. Recording steps in ticket #5234.
